translations.web: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
translations.bsb: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
translations.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow
translations.asv: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.
